messages:
rachel: Heads-up: coordinated rollout in the 02:00-04:00 UTC window. Order: api -> runtime -> router -> console. Versions: api@1.9.0 runtime@2.1.4 router@3.5.7 console@3.9.2. Will run a short canary for runtime. @samuel can you confirm warmup plan?

deploybot: Deploybot: preflight OK at 01:40 UTC. Will apply pins with 5s gaps and emit step events to this thread.

samuel: Ack. Warmup: prime /ops/warmup on all runtime shards at 01:50, then 5% canary for 8m. Priming KV prefixes session/* and ctx/*. Expect minimal eviction.

ivy: Rollback thresholds: sustained error rate >0.5% for 5m OR p99 latency >1s. Staged rollback recommended: unpin router/console first, then api/runtime. @oncall_julie has unpin perms?

oncall_julie: I have perms. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/rollback. Quick unpin snippets below if needed.

```
# unpin router
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"router","version":"3.5.7"}'
# unpin console
curl -X POST "https://ops.internal/releases/unpin" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"service":"console","version":"3.9.2"}'
```

rachel: I'll hold a watch for first 12 minutes and update the release notes with rollback steps and runbook.

deploybot: Starting: api pinned -> runtime pending -> router queued -> console queued (evt: seq_1701).

samuel: Warmup started at 01:50. /ops/warmup returning 200 across shards. Beginning traffic canary now.

ivy: Canary +5m: error rate 0.03%, p99 +10ms. No action. If anything spikes, follow staged unpin order and call #incidents.

oncall_julie: If I execute an unpin I'll: 1) mute noisy alerts 2) run the staged unpins 3) open an incident and post timeline here.

rachel: Thanks all. Posting final note in release notes once router and console are pinned. :white_check_mark:
